name: tabmux
description: Drive Chrome from the keyboard like tmux: a prefix key, modal commands, tab groups, and saved sessions.

open-groups.description: tabmux: open the toolbar popup focused on tab groups (works even where the prefix can't run; needs Chrome 127+)

open-command.description: tabmux: open the toolbar popup focused on the : command-line (same fallback as above; needs Chrome 127+)

create-group.description: tabmux: create a new tab group (opens the toolbar popup, name field ready; same fallback as above; needs Chrome 127+)

create-session.description: tabmux: create a new session (opens the toolbar popup, name field ready; same fallback as above; needs Chrome 127+)
